prompts.directionsPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production 3x3 sprite sheet, NINE HEAD DIRECTIONS for page-mascot.
Reference image: the user's avatar identifies the person only. Redraw him as a BIG HEAD CHIBI CARTOON with a head one and a half times the shoulder width, very large friendly expressive brown eyes, a simplified nose and mouth, thick clean black outlines, subtle pink cheek blush. Keep his warm medium-brown skin, thick swept-up short black hair, thick dark eyebrows, neat short full black beard and moustache. Wear a coral-orange (#ff5c35) short-sleeve collared tropical shirt with simplified dark leaf silhouettes, just like the reference shirt but orange.
Cute storybook sticker art: varied bold outlines, bright white eye catchlights, warm saturated colours, several tones per colour, darker shaded edges and textured tufted hair silhouette. Charming, playful, polished. No photorealism, no heavy 3D gloss, no airbrushed gradients.
LAYOUT: square 1536x1536 canvas, EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows of equally sized 512x512 cells. Head, neck and upper shoulders ONLY, no arms or hands, no props, no lower body. Same head size in every cell. Shoulders two thirds head width. Draw the front-facing body ONCE and reuse the EXACT same neck, chest and shoulders shape, position, shirt pattern, and width in ALL nine cells. ONLY the head rotates.
Each bust occupies roughly 75 percent of its cell height, centered with wide empty margins on ALL four sides and clear empty space BELOW shoulders. Nothing touches cell edges. This sheet is directions, not expressions: the same calm friendly slight smile in every cell.
Row 1: looking UP-LEFT, UP, UP-RIGHT. Row 2: looking LEFT, STRAIGHT AT VIEWER, RIGHT. Row 3: DOWN-LEFT, DOWN, DOWN-RIGHT. Directions relative to the VIEWER: the LEFT cell's nose points toward the LEFT edge of the image. Turn the entire head clearly, not just the eyes. Body always faces viewer.
No floating symbols, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no drop shadows. Background is SOLID FLAT PURE BRIGHT GREEN (#00FF00) edge to edge, including all empty space, no gradients, texture, pattern or checkerboard. A matching expressions sheet will follow; make the proportions and reused body very consistent.
prompts.reactionsPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: matching 3x3 EXPRESSIONS sprite sheet for page-mascot.
Reference: attached directions sheet is the exact character design and layout to preserve. Copy the same man exactly: swept-up tufted short black hair, warm medium-brown skin, thick eyebrows, large brown eyes with white catchlights, neat short full black beard and moustache, coral-orange collared tropical shirt with dark leaf motifs. Same cute storybook chibi sticker art with bold varied outlines, warm shading and subtle cheek blush.
Square image, exactly 3 columns and 3 rows of equal cells. Copy the CENTER cell's front-facing head size, position, hair silhouette, and body for all nine expressions. Body, neck, chest and shoulders must be identical across all cells, same width and baseline as the reference sheet. No hands or arms, no props. Keep wide empty margins and extra room above for small symbols. Every head faces STRAIGHT at viewer; ONLY the expression changes.
Nine expressions left to right, top to bottom:
1 closed eyes as happy upward arcs, calm smile.
2 same closed arc eyes, ONE small red heart floating just above hair.
3 same closed eyes, THREE small golden sparkle stars above hair.
4 very round wide-open eyes, small O mouth of surprise.
5 star-shaped bright eyes, happy smile.
6 closed happy eyes and strong pink blush.
7 closed sleeping eyes, small blue z z z above head.
8 both eyes spiral swirls, wobbly mouth, dizzy.
9 closed happy arc eyes, mouth wide open with big happy grin.
Draw on SOLID FLAT PURE BRIGHT GREEN (#00FF00), the same background as the reference, edge to edge throughout every empty area, no gradient, texture, pattern or checkerboard. No labels, grid lines, borders or drop shadows. Only the small z z z on the sleeping cell is text. Do not change the character's proportions, rendering style, shirt pattern, skin tone or hair colour.
prompts.layoutDirectionsPrompt: Edit target: the attached 3x3 direction sprite sheet. Correct ONLY its layout. Preserve the exact nine drawings, face identity, orange tropical shirt, artwork, colours, poses and ordering. REDUCE EACH ENTIRE BUST TO 65% OF ITS CURRENT SIZE. Arrange the nine smaller busts precisely centered within an invisible equally sized 3 by 3 grid. Each complete bust must occupy NO MORE THAN 60% of its cell HEIGHT, leaving at least 20% empty cell height above AND below every bust. Centers at x=one sixth, one half, five sixths of width and y=one sixth, one half, five sixths of height. A square sheet. The distance between the bottom of one bust and the top of the next row must be LARGE, at least 40% of a cell height. Wide empty space is critical. Do not zoom into or enlarge the drawings to fill the sheet. Body always front-facing, preserve existing head directions. Background SOLID FLAT PURE BRIGHT GREEN #00FF00 throughout all empty space. No labels or grid lines.
prompts.layoutReactionsPrompt:
Edit target: image 1, the orange EXPRESSIONS sheet. Supporting layout reference: image 2, the corrected DIRECTIONS sheet. Correct ONLY the layout of the expressions. Keep the exact nine facial expressions, symbol details, face identity, orange tropical shirt, hair and skin colours and storybook sticker rendering in image 1. REDUCE EACH ENTIRE BUST to match the SMALL BUSTS and VERY WIDE EMPTY MARGINS in image 2. Same head and shoulder dimensions and shoulder baseline as image 2. Each bust occupies only 55% of its cell HEIGHT, precisely centered in an equally spaced 3x3 grid; floating symbols can use a little more height but MUST be fully inside their own cell, well away from edges. Copy the same front-facing body, shape and width in all nine cells. Every head faces directly at viewer, preserve expressions in order: closed arc eyes; closed eyes plus small red heart; closed eyes plus 3 small gold sparkles; surprised eyes and O mouth; star eyes; blushing closed eyes; sleepy with small blue zzz; spiral dizzy eyes; closed eyes big happy grin.
Square image. LARGE EMPTY GAPS between rows, and at least 20% empty cell height below shoulders. NO zooming in to fill space. Background SOLID FLAT PURE BRIGHT GREEN #00FF00 throughout every empty area, no pattern, no checkerboard. No grid lines or labels.
